Possible direction · controlled size task + short strategy questions

Fuchs et al. (2014) used a controlled similarity-search experiment. Eleven of twelve participants completed a post-study questionnaire about aesthetics and strategies; this is a qualitative component within a mixed-method experiment.

Legg et al. asked 20 participants to rate 104 glyph pairs from 0 to 10 for differentiation difficulty. This is quantitative rather than qualitative, but it provides a suitable core task to combine with short explanation prompts.

The 2017 systematic review focused on quantitative controlled studies and found few qualitative field studies. It recommends observation, questionnaires, preferences, and realistic tasks as complementary evidence.
The highlighted direction is a discussion option only. The thesis protocol, participant plan, sizes, stimuli, and measures remain undefined.
